title: Hyper-V Provider Config
description: Host-wide settings for the Hyper-V provider. The boxy agent must run on the Hyper-V host as Administrator.

host_reserve_mb.description: Memory headroom kept available for the host OS and other processes. Defaults to 512 MB; set to 0 to disable the reserve.

data_dir.description: Directory where this provider's restart-safe state is persisted, currently the range-based IP allocation ledger (see network.range on a pool's config, ADR-0012). Relative paths resolve against the boxy config file's own directory when one is known, and against the process's working directory otherwise. Defaults to ".boxy-agent/hyperv".
